The one-click Windows installer now reliably auto-applies the dark theme, with a real installer test in CI.

## Fixed

- **One-click install on stock Windows.** Double-clicking `install.bat` launched Windows PowerShell 5.1, where the branch that auto-sets the FlatLaf dark Look & Feel never ran — so users fell back to picking it by hand, only half-keeping the one-click promise. The launcher now prefers `pwsh` (PowerShell 7) and falls back to 5.1, so the dark theme is applied automatically.

## Added

- A **behavioural installer test** in CI — it runs the installer against a temporary JDownloader directory and asserts the FlatLaf theme JSON landed and the Look & Feel was set, plus a guard so the theme-JSON validation can't pass when it matched no files.
